note: Gold image policy (ADR-0135 §17, ci/coordinator/gold.py). defaults apply to every test; each tests entry whose match (an fnmatch pattern) matches a test name overrides them, in order. group_by names the keys besides the test that select a baseline set (api by default; add device_class or device where baselines differ per device class). mode is decided by the device (exact on a software GPU, perceptual otherwise) unless a test declares it. Perceptual passes need all of (one sRGB level of noise everywhere measures a mean FLIP of about 0.018 at 67 pixels per degree): mean LDR-FLIP <= flip_mean, the share of pixels with FLIP > flip_pixel <= flip_area, SSIM >= ssim_min. max_pixels bounds the pure-Python comparison (an integer box downsample above it; 512x512 takes about 5 s). viewing gives the viewing distance in metres per device kind for the pixels per degree of a device with screen data; any other device uses FLIP's 67 pixels per degree.
